journalProse: The AWS-to-Azure study reinforced that migration is also about separating application concerns from delivery and infrastructure decisions.
What stayed with me: moving a system means understanding the boundaries that make it deployable.
The useful story is not private source code. It is the sanitized architecture, operational choices, and lessons that can be shared safely.
What stayed with me: responsible documentation can make private work understandable without making it exposed.
Running a small service on Oracle Cloud made HTTPS, service supervision, recovery, and deployment part of the project itself.
What stayed with me: a small service still deserves an operational plan.
